overview_description.description: WashOn provides on-demand laundry, dry cleaning, and specialty cleaning services with free pickup and delivery across Dubai. Customers can book via iOS and Android apps or the website, track their orders, and receive their items back freshly cleaned, pressed, and ready to use, typically within 24 hours. The platform combines a digital-first ordering experience with in-house operational control over cleaning, logistics, and quality to deliver consistent results at scale.
